content.value_statement: Core DSL changes can break validation, normalization, diffing, and patch behavior. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused workflow for safe core package updates.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the core package as packages/core and explains its dependency-free role.
Maps DSL validation, normalization, IR conversion, diffing, and patch generation flow.
Lists key TypeScript files for types, validation, normalization, and diff logic.
Describes node and edge type relationships between DSL input and normalized IR.
Provides workflow steps for adding node or edge properties with matching tests.
Documents Bun test commands for all core tests and focused test files.
limitations: It only describes the core package workflow and does not implement changes by itself.
It assumes the repository uses the file names and package paths shown in SKILL.md.
It does not cover UI, CLI, deployment, or package release workflows.
It does not replace a full security review of WebSocket secret handling.

use_cases.title: Add a DSL Node Property
use_cases.description: Update type definitions, validation, normalization defaults, diff behavior, and tests for a new node field.

use_cases.title: Tighten YAML Validation
use_cases.description: Revise validation rules while preserving the expected DSL to IR processing flow.

use_cases.title: Debug Patch Output
use_cases.description: Trace how normalized documents become patch operations and identify missing diff cases.
use_cases.target_user: Developer using Claude Code or Codex

prompt_templates.title: Review a Core Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for guidance before editing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed core package change: [describe change]. Tell me which files in packages/core need updates and which tests should be added.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Node Field
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a coordinated model update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add a new DSL node property named [field]. Update the plan for types, validation, normalization defaults, diff behavior, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Change Validation Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for validation behavior changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to change validation for [rule]. Check how validate, normalize, and diff should respond, then identify focused test cases.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Diff Semantics
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for patch correctness review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the diff behavior for [scenario]. Verify expected patch operations, edge cases, and revision handling in the core package.

output_examples.input: Add an optional color field to nodes.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies type, validation, normalization, diff, and test updates. It recommends default handling and focused coverage for changed node equality.

output_examples.input: A diff test fails after changing edge labels.
output_examples.output: The assistant traces the DSL to IR path, checks edge normalization, and suggests targeted diff assertions for added, changed, and removed edges.

output_examples.input: Validate a new required document field.
output_examples.output: The assistant points to validation rules, normalization assumptions, and tests for missing, invalid, and valid field values.

best_practices: Update types, validation, normalization, diff logic, and tests together for schema changes.
Keep core package changes dependency-free unless the project requirements explicitly change.
Run focused Bun tests after changing validation, normalization, or diff behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not add DSL fields in types without validation and normalization coverage.
Do not change diff equality rules without tests for added, removed, and updated items.
Do not treat WebSocket protocol examples as production security guidance.

faq.question: What package does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on packages/core, which handles DSL validation, normalization, diffing, and patch types.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents hardcoded Bun test commands that a developer or agent may choose to run.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when changing DSL types, validation rules, normalization behavior, or diff output.

faq.question: Does it cover frontend work?
faq.answer: No. It is limited to the core package and related TypeScript processing logic.

faq.question: What tests does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends core package tests and focused tests for diff, validation, and normalization files.
